applicability: Projection of a bounded family roster page for an exact selected family revision in a bound review snapshot.
conditions: The page is selected by the existing knowledge read policy and carries content, membership or realization items.
Only revision IDs represented by those page items are resolved through the recorded membership owner.
exclusions: Unselected revision content and whole-roster fetches.
Family or invariant revision selection, semantic grouping, and authored guarantee or assessment inference.
statement: A bounded family page transports member context for every exact member revision represented by content, membership or realization items, using the existing recorded membership owner without fetching unselected content.
